title: LUMA Brain: A Language Model From Scratch
short_desc: The "brain" behind LUMA: a small AI language model I am building myself, step by step, so the assistant can one day run entirely on my own computer.
blueprint_desc: Instead of relying on a service like ChatGPT, I am learning how these models work from the inside by building one, following Sebastian Raschka's book "Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)". The goal is a small, fast model trained on my own data and on LUMA's skills, so it works offline and keeps my data private. The code is private for now.
tech_notes: Working chapter by chapter through the book to implement every piece myself instead of calling a hosted API: tokenization and data loading, self-attention and multi-head attention, the GPT-style transformer block, pretraining on unlabeled text, and fine-tuning for classification and instruction following. The goal is a lightweight model that is easy on CPU/GPU, trained on my own data and on Luma's tools and skills, so the assistant can answer and act fully offline. The source code is currently private.
